item.title: Course Flyover: St. George’s Golf Club
item.description: Stanley Thompson’s best Canadian golf course is an oft-debated topic, but in the opinion of our course raters, his masterpiece sits in Toronto’s west end. St. George’s Golf Club came in at No. 2 on our Top 100 list two years ago and continues to justify that lofty position. Its rolling fairways flow effortlessly across the property, and are complemented by bunkering that is both visually striking and subtly deceptive.
